content.name: Megan MacDonald
content.title: Store Manager
content.summary: First-time store manager with a Saint Mary's BCom, now running a busy downtown bookstore and gift shop in Halifax. Took over in early 2025 and grew sales 12% in the first year by adding author events and a cruise-season gift section.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Manage a $1.4M bookstore and gift shop with nine staff, owning scheduling, ordering, cash and monthly reporting to the owner.
Grew 2025 sales by 12% by booking 22 author events and creating a local-makers section aimed at cruise ship visitors.
Reduced overstock returns to publishers by 18% by switching to weekly sell-through reviews by category.
Hired and trained four new part-time booksellers, including two Dalhousie students for the evening shift.

experience.title: Assistant Store Manager
bullets: Supported the store manager of a garden centre with 25 seasonal staff, running the floor on weekends and evenings.
Organized spring receiving for 400 pallets of plants and soil, keeping best sellers in stock during the eight-week peak.
Created a simple closing checklist that cut cash variances from an average of $45 a night to under $10.
Handled customer complaints and refunds, keeping Google reviews above 4.5.

education.degree: Bachelor of Commerce, Major in Marketing
education.details: Retail strategy course project on independent bookstores in Atlantic Canada.
